in_marathi.name: Arka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arka is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Arka', which means the radiance of the sun. In Hindu mythology, Arka is the name of the sun god. The name is deeply rooted in the spiritual significance of the sun, which represents vitality, power, and enlightenment.
